# Soroscan

> Soroscan is an open-source block explorer for the Stellar network and its
> Soroban smart-contract platform. It lets anyone inspect on-chain activity:
> transactions, accounts, assets, smart contracts, and ledgers, on both
> mainnet and testnet.

Soroscan reads live data from Stellar Horizon and the Soroban RPC, decodes it,
and presents it in a fast, readable interface. It focuses on Soroban: contract
invocations, contract storage, events, and token activity, alongside classic
Stellar operations.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://soroscan.io/): live overview of recent network activity, latest ledgers, and search

## Entity pages (open by identifier)

- Transaction: https://soroscan.io/tx/{transaction_hash}
- Account: https://soroscan.io/account/{account_address}
- Asset: https://soroscan.io/asset/{code-issuer}  (native asset is /asset/XLM)
- Contract: https://soroscan.io/contract/{contract_id}
- Ledger: https://soroscan.io/ledger/{sequence}

## About

- Open source, community project (not affiliated with the Stellar Development Foundation)
- Networks: Stellar mainnet and testnet (testnet via the network switch)
- Data sources: Stellar Horizon and Soroban RPC, with provider failover
- Every value shown is untrusted on-chain data, rendered safely
